hypr/bindings.lua.text:
-- Vim-style focus: Super + H/J/K/L
hl.unbind("SUPER + J")
hl.unbind("SUPER + K")
hl.unbind("SUPER + L")
hl.unbind("SUPER + LEFT")
hl.unbind("SUPER + RIGHT")
hl.unbind("SUPER + UP")
hl.unbind("SUPER + DOWN")

hl.unbind("SUPER + H")
o.bind("SUPER + H", "Focus on left window", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "l" }))
o.bind("SUPER + J", "Focus on below window", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "d" }))
o.bind("SUPER + K", "Focus on above window", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "u" }))
hl.unbind("SUPER + L")
o.bind("SUPER + L", "Focus on right window", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "r" }))

-- Vim-style window swapping: Super + Shift + H/J/K/L
hl.unbind("SUPER + SHIFT + LEFT")
hl.unbind("SUPER + SHIFT + DOWN")
hl.unbind("SUPER + SHIFT + UP")
hl.unbind("SUPER + SHIFT + RIGHT")

o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + H", "Swap window to the left", hl.dsp.window.swap({ direction = "l" }))
o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + J", "Swap window down", hl.dsp.window.swap({ direction = "d" }))
o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + K", "Swap window up", hl.dsp.window.swap({ direction = "u" }))
o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + L", "Swap window to the right", hl.dsp.window.swap({ direction = "r" }))

o.bind("SUPER + LEFT", "Toggle window split", hl.dsp.layout("togglesplit"))
o.bind("SUPER + DOWN", "Keybindings", "omarchy-menu-keybindings")
o.bind("SUPER + RIGHT", "Cycle workspace layout (including Wide)", (os.getenv("HOME") or "") .. "/.config/hypr/workspace-layout-cycle")
o.bind("SUPER + UP", "Next workspace", hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = "e+1" }))

-- Move to scratchpad with Shift, replacing the Google Maps shortcut.
hl.unbind("SUPER + ALT + S")
o.rebind("SUPER + SHIFT + S", "Move window to scratchpad", hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = "special:scratchpad", follow = false }))

-- Include Herdr in universal copy/paste.
require("hypr.herdr-clipboard")

-- Cmdtab captures its own keys in a dedicated submap while open.
dofile((os.getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") or os.getenv("HOME") .. "/.config")
  .. "/omarchy/plugins/illegalstudio.omarchy-cmdtab/hyprland.lua")("SUPER")

hypr/looknfeel.lua.text:
-- Resize floating windows by dragging a border or corner without SUPER.
    resize_on_border = true,

-- Fade special workspaces in and out, including the scratchpad.
hl.animation({ leaf = "specialWorkspaceIn", enabled = true, speed = 3, bezier = "easeOutQuint", style = "fade" })
hl.animation({ leaf = "specialWorkspaceOut", enabled = true, speed = 2, bezier = "easeInOutCubic", style = "fade" })

hypr/hyprland.lua.text:
-- Defines omarchy_workspace_set_wide before saved workspace layouts load.
require("hypr.wide-layout")

-- Terminal BEL/OSC alerts (AI agents in tmux, Codex, etc.) must not steal focus.
o.window({ tag = "terminal" }, { focus_on_activate = false })

-- Brave automation must not switch workspaces through activation requests.
o.window("^(brave-browser)$", { focus_on_activate = false })

-- Nautilus, file manager and open/save chooser, opens floating.
-- Anchored so org.gnome.NautilusPreviewer keeps its own rule.
o.window("^(org\\.gnome\\.Nautilus)$", { float = true })

-- Fullscreen RustDesk forwards shortcuts, except Super+1 to workspace 1.
require("hypr.rustdesk-shortcuts")
